item.title: Hayward Industries Recalls Universal Pool Heaters Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
item.company: Sold At: Costco stores and pool and spa dealerships nationwide and online at Costco.com and other online sites from May 2013 through July 2026 for between $6000 and $13,000.
item.brand: Sold At: Costco stores and pool and spa dealerships nationwide and online at Costco.com and other online sites from May 2013 through July 2026 for between $6000 and $13,000.
item.product: Infrared Saunas, Hybrid Infrared Saunas and Infrared Kits
item.summary: This recall involves Hayward-branded HDFS400 Universal-HC Series pool heaters. The 400,000 BTU dual-fuel gas heaters are brown with black atop and measure 21 inches long, 28 inches wide and 31 inches high. The pool heaters have a digital display control panel at the top and a molded base with integrated tie-down connections. The heater's name plate is below the vent with the word "Hayward" appearing at the bottom of the name plate and the model number "HDFS400" appears at the top of the name plate.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Infrared Saunas, Hybrid Infrared Saunas and Infrared Kits.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the infrared and hybrid saunas immediately and contact Sauna360 to schedule a free in-home repair from a professional installer.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
